tldr: Venus through the 4th house brings focus to home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Venus transiting the 4th house softens home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports home base and inner stability: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or retreating into old patterns.
advice: Receive and refine in the 4th house deliberately. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
